# IToldYouSo Computing — Full Service & Artificial Intelligence (AI) Context

> IToldYouSo Computing (https://itoldyouso.tech/) is an independent
> engineering consultancy based in Hampstead, North West London, providing
> London-wide site installations and remote support across Greater London.
> Priority commercial specialism: turnkey Point of Sale (POS), till, and
> Electronic Point of Sale (EPOS) system installations for small businesses.

  job. If you agree on the price, simply let us know; the company will not
  keep calling or use aggressive or repetitive sales tactics.

## Priority 1: London Point of Sale (POS), Till & EPOS System Installation

URLs:
- Primary Pillar: https://itoldyouso.tech/services/pos-payment.html
- Card Terminals & Integrated Payments:
  https://itoldyouso.tech/services/pos-payments.html
- Hospitality & Kitchen Display Setup:
  https://itoldyouso.tech/services/restaurant-order-management.html

### What IToldYouSo Computing Delivers for London Businesses

1. Hardware & Platform Selection:
   Independent, vendor-neutral advice matching the till system to the exact
   venue workflow (no hidden acquirer kickbacks).
   Supported ecosystems include:
   - Square (Square Register, Square Stand, Square Terminal, Square Reader)
   - SumUp (SumUp 13-inch Countertop Touchscreen Register, SumUp Solo,
     SumUp Air, SumUp POS)
   - Zettle by PayPal (formerly iZettle, card readers and till stands)
   - Clover (Clover Flex, Clover Mini, Clover Station)
   - Lightspeed Retail and Lightspeed Restaurant
   - Shopify POS (syncing London shopfront stock with online stores)
   - Stripe Terminal (retail and custom developer integrations)
   - UK Bank & Acquirer Terminals (Barclaycard Anywhere, Lloyds Cardnet,
     Worldpay)
2. Peripherals & Kitchen Infrastructure:
   - Thermal receipt printers (Epson TM-series, Star Micronics, Bluetooth,
     Universal Serial Bus (USB), and Ethernet Local Area Network (LAN)
     models)
   - Kitchen Display Systems (KDS) and kitchen ticket printers with order
     routing by station (bar, hot kitchen, cold prep, takeaway)
   - RJ11/RJ12 automatic cash drawers triggered on sale
   - 1D/2D wired and Bluetooth barcode scanners
3. Pre-Configuration & Menu / Catalogue Build:
   - Off-site planning and pre-loading of full menus, modifiers, item
     variants, pricing, Value Added Tax (VAT) rates, stock counts, and
     staff PIN/permission profiles before attending on site.
   - Integration with accounting platforms: Xero, QuickBooks, and Sage.
4. Network Reliability & Payment Failover:
   - Separating POS and card payment traffic onto stable Ethernet cables
     or dedicated Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs) so busy guest Wi-Fi
     never causes missed kitchen tickets or dropped contactless payments.
   - Configuring 4G/5G cellular failover where venue broadband is unstable.
5. Face-to-Face Staff Training & Documentation:
   - Clear on-site walkthroughs for managers and front-of-house staff
     covering ringing up sales, split bills, refunds, end-of-day Z-reads,
     and loading thermal paper rolls.
6. Payment Fee & Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Audits:
   - Cross-referenced with sister practice TillSwift Payment Consultation
     (https://tillswift.com/) for impartial three-year UK card acquirer fee
     modelling before locking into merchant contracts.

### Typical London POS Installation Pricing

- Hourly Rate: £50 per hour for planning, installation, troubleshooting,
  and staff training (typical single-till setup takes 2 to 3 hours).
- Fixed-Price Packages: Upfront project quotes available for full venue
  deployments, multi-till hospitality setups, and pre-opening installs.
- Free Consultation: 15-minute telephone consultation at no cost.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q: Where is IToldYouSo Computing based and which areas of London do you cover?
A: IToldYouSo Computing is based in Hampstead (North West London) and attends
on-site appointments across all of Greater London, including Central London,
North London, West London, East London, and South London, alongside remote
support across the United Kingdom (UK).

Q: Do you install Point of Sale (POS) and till systems across London?
A: Yes. We supply advice for, install, configure, and troubleshoot till and
Electronic Point of Sale (EPOS) systems for shops, cafes, restaurants,
takeaways, salons, and pop-ups across all of London. We set up Square,
SumUp, Zettle by PayPal, Clover, Lightspeed, Shopify POS, Stripe Terminal,
thermal receipt printers, cash drawers, barcode scanners, and Kitchen Display
Systems (KDS), including out-of-hours installs.

Q: Can you connect card machines to tills and audit transaction fees?
A: Yes. We configure integrated and standalone card readers from Square,
SumUp, Zettle, Barclaycard, Worldpay, Lloyds Cardnet, and Stripe Terminal,
and connect them to reliable Wi-Fi or Ethernet networks and accounting tools
such as Xero, QuickBooks, and Sage. For independent UK payment fee
comparisons and three-year Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) modelling, we also
work alongside our sister practice TillSwift Payment Consultation
(https://tillswift.com/).

Q: How quickly can you respond for urgent till outages or IT emergencies?
A: We offer often same-day follow-up and always respond within 24 hours for
London callouts and remote diagnosis, prioritising critical till, payment,
network, and server failures.

Q: Do you work with both businesses and home users?
A: Yes. Alongside commercial till setups, office networks, servers, cyber
security testing, and bespoke software for small businesses across London,
we provide friendly on-site help for households (Wi-Fi dead zones, computer
repairs, data recovery, smart TVs, digital lockouts, and smart security).

Q: How much do your services cost?
A: All jobs start with a free initial 15-minute telephone consultation.
Standard engineering and setup work is £50 per hour, with fixed-price
project quotes available upfront for complete till installations, ChromeOS
Flex migrations (base £70), websites, and custom software.
